field_updates.detail: Outline 'Case Style WOG' (p3, inspected image): '+' upper-left, '~' upper-right, '~' lower-left, '-' lower-right, square lead pattern 0.180-0.220 in on both axes. Diagonal pairs are invariant under the unproven view rotation/mirror; pin 1 = '+' is the library convention (PCB_COMPONENT_3D_LIBRARY_SPEC.md OHM-072), not a manufacturer number.

field_updates.detail: Least-squares fit of VF = N*Vt*ln(I/IS+1)+I*RS (Vt at 298.15 K) to the five lowest vertices of the vector polyline of Fig. 3 'Typical Forward Characteristics Per Diode' (TJ 25 C, 300 us pulse): (0.6085 V, 10.5 mA), (0.7899 V, 0.1027 A), (0.9989 V, 1.937 A), (1.0793 V, 4.92 A), (1.1376 V, 7.15 A); axis calibrated on gridlines (133.25 pt/V, 32.555 pt/decade). RMS 7.8 mV, max 11.2 mV. IS and N trade off; use as a set. Above 7 A the curve bends (excluded).

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Physical role binding remains unverified for the generic WOM/WOG combined entry. Resolution: Scope the binding to Vishay W10G only (DF10M precedent, D031); MCC WOM stays unbound. The Vishay WOG outline (doc 88769 p3, inspected image) marks '+' and '-' on one diagonal of the square lead pattern and the two '~' on the other diagonal, with equal 4.6-5.6 mm spacing on both axes. Every rotation or mirror of a square maps diagonals to diagonals, so the unresolved top-view/lead-end-view transform can only exchange which AC lead is library pin 2 vs 4. The library anchors pin 1 to the '+' lead (3D spec OHM-072 'OHMNI default pin 1 = +'), so PLUS=1 and MINUS=3 (diagonal) are fixed, and AC1/AC2 are electrically interchangeable in the four-identical-diode model; the existing bridge probe already tests both AC polarities. Hence the transform does not need to be proven for the electrical binding. Second problem found: with the class proxy card (IS 1.04e-10, N 1.8, RS 0.03) a W10G diode drops ~1.09 V at 1 A, above the W10G 1.0 V maximum, so the bridge probe (2*vf_max = 2.0 V) would fail; a W10G-specific forward fit from its own Fig. 3 is proposed (two-junction drop 1.895 V, passes).
MCC WOM reference and its AC,AC,+,- statement remain unresolved and unbound.
Capacitive-input derating and surge (IFSM 50 A, I2t 10) not modelled.
Physical check that the footprint places pin 1 under the '+' mark.
